REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: Governance classification can be bypassed by modifying the executable contract gate or its fixtures under an ordinary refactor record.
FINDING: high|scripts/factory-ng-provenance-validate.py|FACTORY_CONTRACT_FILES omits scripts/test_factory_ng_contracts.py and the contract-review fixture tree|Those files define schema/gate acceptance checks, so changing them can alter Factory acceptance without factory classification or required Sol/Opus review.
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Classify scripts/test_factory_ng_contracts.py and docs/factory-ng/fixtures/contract-review/ as Factory-contract paths, derive the appropriate affected areas/high-impact scope, and add path-evasion fixtures for both.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: Submit change_class=refactor, contract_change_scope=none, changed_paths=["scripts/test_factory_ng_contracts.py"], then remove or invert a high-impact validation assertion; the provenance validator permits an ordinary reviewer despite weakened acceptance governance.
